3. **"he's say" → "he said"** and **"he are not sure" → "he wasn't sure"** (simplified contractions and correct tense form).  
4. **"asked me to looking for it" → "asked me to look for it"** (corrected verb form).  
5. **"she's say" → "she said"** and **"I responds" → "I responded"** (subject-verb agreement and correct tense).  
6. **"ain't no sure" → "I'm not sure"** (standardized phrasing).  
7. **"he not heard me" → "he didn't hear me"** (correct tense and subject-verb agreement).
